description: Wheelr is a free web app for giveaways, raffles and random selection: you add entries to a customizable wheel, spin it, and it picks one at random. No account required; a free Android app is also available.

agentContent.contentNegotiation: Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any page URL to receive markdown instead of the HTML app shell.

endpoints.purpose: Machine-readable index of the site for AI agents
Full text of every page in a single response
Markdown version of a page (index, info, templates, privacy, donation)
